# Anne Shirley & Harrison

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) — neighbors who become good friends · since v2  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), +1 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is interrupted while daydreaming by Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), their angry neighbor, who complains that her cow has broken into his oats. After a heated argument, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) pen-up the cow, and later discusses the incident and local gossip with [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>
> — v2 · I An Irate Neighbor

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038)_

> While returning from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) spot a cow ruining Mr. Harrison's oat field. Believing it to be her own unruly cow, [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hastily sells the animal to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md) on the spot. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers [Dolly](../character/dolly.md) safe in her pen and realizes she accidentally sold Mr. Harrison's cow instead.
>
> — v2 · II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure

_Sources: [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P12](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0012), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P23](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0023), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P24](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0024), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P35](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0035)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to Mr. Harrison's house to confess that she accidentally sold his Jersey cow to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md). To her relief, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) takes the news calmly and agrees to accept Anne's cow in exchange. They share tea and cake, bonding despite insults from Mr. Harrison's foul-mouthed parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to share the happy outcome with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v2 · III Mr. Harrison at Home

_Sources: [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P20](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0020), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P35](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0035), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P53](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0053)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) discuss their different philosophies on teaching and discipline the evening before the school term begins. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who also doubts her plan to avoid corporal punishment. The next morning, a nervous [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares for her first day of teaching with encouragement and ginger tea from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v2 · IV Different Opinions

_Sources: [v2 IV Different Opinions P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 IV Different Opinions P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007), [v2 IV Different Opinions P35](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0035), [v2 IV Different Opinions P41](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0041)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue their fundraising canvass, encountering various quirky neighbors including the neat freak Mrs. Theodore White and the overjoyed [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md), who donates handsomely following the birth of his son. Later that evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to ask for a subscription, but he flatly refuses.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P40](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0040), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P49](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0049), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P55](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0055), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P57](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0057)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and the village hall project with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). After the painter finishes, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discovers that the hall has been painted a glaring blue instead of green due to a mix-up with the paint order numbers. The news spreads, devastating the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), but the villagers rally behind the young people while blaming the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes) for the mistake.
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P25](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0025), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns from school enjoying the autumn day until [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reveals that [Dora](../character/dora.md) is missing. After a frantic search and dragging the well, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses he trapped her there and lied about it, but breaks down when he realizes lying is wrong, leading [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to punish and educate him.
>
> — v2 · X Davy in Search of a Sensation

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P9](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0009), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052)_

> In a miserable mood caused by a toothache, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has a terrible day at school, accidentally causing firecrackers to explode in the stove and losing her temper enough to whip [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) for putting a mouse in her desk. That evening, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comforts a remorseful [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). To Anne's surprise, the punishment earns Anthony's respect, as later confirmed when he behaves pleasantly and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) shares his approval.
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P40](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0040), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invites [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to celebrate her spring "adopted birthday" with a picnic walk through the woods with [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md). On Saturday, the four girls explore new paths, name a woodland pool "[Crystal Lake](../codex/places.md#crystal-lake)," and discover the forgotten, flower-filled garden of [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md). Sitting among the narcissi, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) shares the poignant story of Hester's life and death, which deeply touches [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v2 · XIII A Golden Picnic

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P1](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0001), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P29](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0029), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044)_

> Uncle Abe's weather prediction unexpectedly comes true when a destructive hail and lightning storm strikes [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), severely damaging crops, trees, and buildings. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and the twins weather the fury of the tempest at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) before assessing the community-wide destruction, which includes the loss of Mr. Harrison's parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md).
>
> — v2 · XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P33](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0033), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) speaks with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) when a well-dressed woman arrives in a wagon looking for Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). The visitor reveals she is Mr. Harrison's wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), and leaves to go to his house. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss the surprise, and later [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) add further details about Emily's return.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P25](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0025), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047)_

> Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) the background of his marital separation and how his late parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md) led to their split before [Emily](../character/emily.md) returned. Mrs. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) walks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back toward [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), expressing her own regrets about being too hasty, while Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discusses the Harrisons with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P65](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0065), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P67](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0067)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) works on writing her story, "Averil's Atonement," sharing her drafts with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and receiving blunt critiques from Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). After sending the completed manuscript to two different magazines and receiving rejections from both, a disheartened [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to lock the story away and abandon her literary ambitions.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XII “Averil’s Atonement”

_Sources: [v3 ch.Atonement” P28](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0028), [v3 ch.Atonement” P41](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0041), [v3 ch.Atonement” P60](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0060), [v3 ch.Atonement” P67](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0067)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns from Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) about a baking powder story contest, only to be horrified when [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) reveals she edited and submitted Anne's story 'Averil's Atonement,' winning the prize. Although distraught over her work being turned into an advertisement, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is somewhat comforted when [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) offers a practical perspective on the matter.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XV A Dream Turned Upside Down

_Sources: [v3 ch.Down P4](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0004), [v3 ch.Down P11](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0011), [v3 ch.Down P22](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0022), [v3 ch.Down P35](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0035)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holidays, which are dampened by severe winter weather, awkward visits from [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and worries about her college finances. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) engages [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in amusing chatter until Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) delivers the mail. Among the letters, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives news that Miss Josephine Barry has died and left her a thousand dollars in her will.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVIII Miss Josephine Remembers the Anne-girl
